name: Gigatrans LTD
notes:
The national telecommunications operator GigaTrans was established in 2006 and is a member of GIGAGROUP, which also includes the commercial GigaCenter data centre, GigaCloud cloud operator and GigaSafe cybersecurity agency.

The Company works with a thousand clients and has 500 partners in Ukraine and globally. GigaTrans provides the Internet connection and data transmission channelling services for businesses of any scale and state enterprises.

GigaTrans implements comprehensive IT solutions for each client’s needs and offers installation of the server equipment at the data centre, development of the cloud infrastructure and protection of a business from cyber threats and DDoS attacks.
